_doc: Packaging allowlist. Every packaged file is one entry here; the build copies nothing that is not listed. `legacy` classifies every existing harness file so nothing is silently dropped or vendored. Kinds map to package paths: skill -> skills/<id>/SKILL.md (+ agents/openai.yaml for codex), reference -> references/, template -> templates/, schema -> schemas/, script -> scripts/, script-lib -> scripts/lib/, adapter -> scripts/adapters/<host-dir>/, hook-adapter -> scripts/adapters/<host-dir>/ (hooks.json -> hooks/hooks.json, host-specific), hook-core -> hooks/core/, contract -> contracts/, memory-template -> templates/memory/<rel>, manifest -> generated native manifest. An entry may carry an explicit package-relative `output` (never absolute, never ..) and a `host` restriction.

digest_inputs._doc: Source digest = every file under these roots plus these globs. Generated output (packages/, dist/, marketplace manifests, docs/harness/) is never an input.
